name: Spartan
fix_description: In calcLiquidityShare, use cached balances (baseAmountPooled/tokenAmountPooled) instead of querying current balance (which can be inflated via direct transfer). This prevents attackers from inflating the pool balance before burning LP tokens to claim disproportionate underlying assets.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit requires understanding a non-obvious LP share/accounting flaw in SpartanPool, specifically how add/remove liquidity interacts with spot balances versus reserves, then chaining repeated swaps, liquidity adds, donations, and withdrawals in a precise sequence. Even though the PoC is not very long, it is a protocol-specific multi-step attack with repeated state manipulation and reserve desynchronization that would likely take an experienced auditor more than 2 hours to derive from scratch.
